subject: Vendor onboarding: insurance intake matrix + PO timing (NovaPlace)
messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novaplace.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New vendor setup: docs needed for PO issuance

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We are ready to proceed with vendor setup so we can receive POs from Redwood. Can you confirm what evidence you need from NovaPlace for procurement to issue the PO? At a minimum we can immediately provide:

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing general liability and professional liability
- Completed IRS W-9
- Primary contact for billing and EDI (we'll include that)

Two specific questions: 1) does Redwood require an additional insured endorsement or waiver of subrogation? 2) What is the expected lead time from evidence receipt to PO issuance?

I can attach COI and W-9 once you confirm the target formats.

Best,
Ethan Cole
Sr. Procurement Manager
NovaPlace
ethan.cole@novaplace.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novaplace.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup: docs needed for PO issuance

Hi Ethan — thanks, and welcome.

Quick answers up front:
- We typically require COI with Redwood Inference listed as the certificate holder and an Additional Insured endorsement for General Liability when the supplier will be performing services or handling data. Cyber/Errors & Omissions is requested for SaaS/hosting vendors.
- W-9 in PDF is fine.
- Typical lead time is 3–5 business days once required evidence and any requested endorsements are received, assuming no follow-up gaps.

I attached our onboarding intake matrix (Vendor-Insurance-Intake-Template.xlsx) to make this easier — it lists the exact fields we capture for the COI and the endorsement language we need to see. Please fill what you can and attach your COI + W-9. If an endorsement is not possible, let me know and we can discuss conditional PO options.

Also copying Kimberly from Risk to confirm endorsement language.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Procurement Program Manager
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: Vendor-Insurance-Intake-Template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: New vendor setup: docs needed for PO issuance

Kimberly / Priyom — forwarding NovaPlace request. They can provide COI and W-9 immediately. Can you confirm: 1) whether the Additional Insured endorsement we request is mandatory for this supplier class (SaaS integration partner), and 2) if we can approve a conditional PO pending a signed endorsement within 10 business days?

Context: NovaPlace will handle customer onboarding workflows and may access customer metadata during integrations; risk flagged for E&O. If we need a hold, please advise wording for our intake tracker and whether a PO stub should be delayed.

Appreciate quick guidance — expecting external docs later today.

—Marcus

From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novaplace.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup: docs needed for PO issuance

Marcus — attaching the COI and W-9 as discussed.

Attachment: nova_coi_2028-04-11.pdf (PDF stub)
Attachment: nova_w9_2028-04-11.pdf (PDF stub)

We included General Liability (1M/2M), Professional Liability/E&O (1M), and Cyber (1M) on the COI. The broker says they can provide an Additional Insured endorsement naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." but it will take 5–7 business days to issue the endorsement document from signature.

If Redwood can issue a conditional PO with standard hold language while we deliver the endorsement, that would keep timelines moving. Otherwise we can expedite but may hit the endorsement delay. Please advise and let me know if any COI fields need correction.

Thanks,
Ethan

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novaplace.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-12T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup: docs needed for PO issuance

Ethan — got the COI and W-9, thank you. I reviewed the certificate and it looks complete for our onboarding intake.

Kimberly confirmed that for this supplier class we prefer an Additional Insured endorsement for General Liability but will accept a conditional PO for up to 10 business days while the endorsement is issued. Our conditional PO language will require: (1) endorsement naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." as Additional Insured on the General Liability policy, and (2) endorsement to be received and confirmed within 10 business days of PO date or the PO will be paused.

I'm attaching a PO stub (redwood_po_stub_2028-04-12.pdf) that procurement will use to kick off billing once the vendor profile is created. Please confirm billing contact and whether the endorsement ETA of 5–7 business days will work — if so we'll issue a conditional PO immediately and queue finance onboarding.

Next steps:
- NovaPlace: confirm billing contact + accept conditional PO timeline (reply to this thread)
- Redwood: Procurement will issue conditional PO after acceptance; Risk will monitor endorsement receipt

Thanks again — looking forward to getting you onboarded.

Marcus Lin
Procurement Program Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_po_stub_2028-04-12.pdf (PDF stub)
